title: teamai-cli
brief: Tencent's "Make Every Team AI Native" CLI. The description is thin, but a Tencent-backed team-AI CLI is worth a look.
details: TeamAI (Tencent/teamai-cli, 5.1k stars) is "the shared foundation for how your team works, learns, and improves with AI" — it turns individual AI capabilities into shared team capabilities across agents, machines, and members. Everything is built on Git: an admin creates a shared-experience repo, members run `teamai init <repo>` (project or user scope), and every AI session then auto-pulls the latest skills, rules, docs, env, hooks, MCP servers, and models published by admins — no manual sync. Three layers: Team Execution (every agent works the team's way), Team Context beta (learnings, codebase graph, teamwiki), and Team Improvement beta (usage, sessions, dashboard). Broad agent coverage: full feature support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, and Qoder, with capability-limited support for OpenCode, Pi, OpenClaw, and others. Setup is one line to your AI tool or `npm install -g teamai-cli`. MIT.
